items.title: The units at stage 1: the µeV core kept, the scale fixed by convention, one lever-arm ratio in θ
items.chose: keep the µeV core and carry one lever-arm ratio in θ: the gate does not need the absolute scale (§8bd)
over: a full lever-arm matrix in θ: more parameters than one detuning sweep can identify
volts throughout: ties the core to one device's calibration
evidence: §8bd: placing the gate does not need the absolute energy scale
items.recheck: RIKEN's exchange against barrier voltage is 2.6x shallower than the prior assumed (19 Oct)
items.affects: barrier control step 7 · the prior's width on t_c

items.title: The input layer, built: the typical gate three times closer, no failure fixed, and the diagram weakest where it matters
items.chose: a diagram and the qubit frequencies become the crowd's starting box, carried by flow.Box
over: seeding the crowd from a network: retired in §8bc
evidence: typical gate 3x closer to the best on the battery

items.title: The scope: QUAST starts where the lab's tools stop - a device ready for two-qubit work
items.chose: start from a device ready for two-qubit work; the input layer first, then barrier control
over: from formed dots with a working sensor (§8be): duplicates the lab's own tools
evidence: handoff.md: what QUAST assumes it is given, and from where

items.title: Mixed precision on a graphics card: a tune-up in about six seconds, gates as good as double
items.chose: a mixed-precision mode on the graphics card, opt-in
over: double precision on the card: no faster than the laptop (§8ao)
evidence: gate quality matches double on every battery device

items.title: The placement menu was the largest loss in the system; the gate is now placed continuously, and the guard is back
items.chose: place the gate continuously, and restore the guard
over: the placement menu: the largest single loss measured
evidence: the menu's cost measured against continuous placement on the battery

items.title: The loop cleaned up: the guard and the second opinion retired, knowingly
items.chose: retire the guard and the second opinion
evidence: neither changed a verdict on the battery at the time

items.title: The crowd drives the loop: 44 times closer to the best gate, every earlier failure fixed
items.chose: sequential Monte Carlo (the crowd) drives the loop; the network is no longer in it
over: the amortised normalising-flow posterior: overconfident on the designs it chose (§8l, §8v)
items.affects: everything since: the v2 design (§8ba) is built on it
